newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria prepares evacuation from Albania.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria prepares evacuation from Albania.

text.p: Bulgarian Foreign Minister Stoyan Stalev said on Thursday three planes were on standby to evacuate Bulgarians from Albania if they could get access to Tirana airport.
The foreign ministry on Wednesday advised the 100-odd Bulgarians in Albania to leave because of increasing unrest in the former Stalinist dictatorship.
"Three Hemus Air planes are prepared to evacuate Bulgarian citizens from Albania, when access to Tirana airport is given," Stalev told reporters.

International airline officials in the capital Tirana reported the airport was closed on Thursday morning, hampering the evacuation of some foreign embassy staff and families ordered by their governments.
For the first time in two months of chaos, shooting was heard overnight in Tirana in the north of the country after looters fired newly-acquired weapons into the air in celebration.
Unrest, ignited by anger at a devastating savings fraud, had hitherto been confined to the south.
